notes.content:

Game Mode - Defense Mode

No single life mode now, players now have unlimited lives just like other game modes.
The location to set landmine is down to one. Attack team wins when the mine explodes.

notes.title: UPDATE NOTICE : v1.2 New weapons, maps and more!
notes.content:
Due to critical issues, we have rolled back certain features from v1.2 temporarily.


Greetings Soldiers!

We have a big update for you guys today!  Battle it out in the Pacific Theater with new weapons and maps! 

The BOT system has also be updated, lobby host can now choose the BOTs army and difficulty from the lobby menu. 

With this update we also have added a game mode that many of you have been asking for: Limited Weapons mode. The lobby host now has the ability to turn off and restrict weapons to open up games modes such as Snipers only. 

Let us know what you guys think of the update and what you would like to see in the future! 

As always, we are continually trying to fine-tune our game and listening to your feedback! Please let us know what you guys think and keep sending the constructive feedback and ideas our way. 

Here’s the full list of updates below.

Weapons:

 New Rifle - Garand Rifle
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31409256/d0ca88e83b7632f4b636d8ee6d96225d144e3590.jpg 
 New SMG - Type 100
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31409256/1cc379cbddedc042180c15e42c4199ab6b1d606e.jpg



 Maps:

 New Map - Jungle Warfare 

 Will support Team Deathmatch, Attack and Defend, and FFA

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31409256/ca144092e1e16c97dc174483100c50c19f68ba97.jpg


 New Map - Island

 Will support Team Deathmatch, Attack and Defend, and FFA

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31409256/7636c08b8e40420bf4df081ce85b92487c19c4a1.jpg


 Bridge 

 Added support for Attack and Defend




 Game Settings:

 New game modes

 Limited Weapon modes
 
 Lobby host can choose which weapons can be used during the match (example: Snipers only or Knifes only) 
 Weapons cannot be chosen in game
 Bazookas / Mounted Machine guns will be disabled in this mode





 BOT settings

 Customize the names and looks of the BOTs
 Difficulty settings added for BOTs
 Choose between: Easy / Normal / Hard





 Ranking System:

 Medals

 Special medal system - player can choose which medals to wear
 Added Pacific theater battlefield related medals




Upcoming Changes:

 Tutorial mode
 New Army

 Including theme maps, weapon, avatars

 New Weapons
 New Achievements / Medals

notes.title: v1.0 Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31409256/9efdbd02390634ea664d613b20785c392bed0769.gif

Greetings Soldiers!

We have a quite a big update for the veterans of the game today! 

We are happy to announce our ranking and medal system along with a revamped weapon system. 

All the current weapons have been updated to include a bolt action or cocking feature which will be required after the gun has been reloaded. 

We really wanted to include the feature that lets players hold the weapon from the front with either hand so that they can reload with the main hand. We are working on pushing this out and it should be out within a month. In the meantime, we hope that players can familiarize themselves with the revamped weapons. 

The next update will be a big one and we hope to have your continued support

As always, we are continually trying to fine-tune our game and listening to your feedback! Please let us know what you guys think and keep sending the constructive feedback and ideas our way. 

Here’s the full list of updates below. 

Ranking System:


 Players can now rank up

 Players will be able to earn various ranks and medals by playing the the game! 
Ranks will be shown in game and lobby next to the players name
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31409256/5599f01e651f83cbe3fd6c61b272dfe219741383.png

Leaderboard

 The leaderboard will be reset monthly and will be based on

Game Settings:


 Attack/Defend mode

 Added disarm message/reminder - When all players are dead but the bombs are still planted. 



                                    

Weapons:

Revamped all guns 

All guns now have a bolt action system that will require interaction after reloading to shoot again

notes.title: v0.99 Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31409256/570e0f24cb03642ac3ebf4333e77eb3ef852c77f.jpg

Greetings Soldiers!

We have a new update for you guys today! 

We are happy to announce that our DOM (Attack/Defend) game mode has been revamped. Players will have to carefully plan out their attack route as there are no longer respawns in this game mode. We are still fine-tuning this mode so let us know what you guys think! 

Also, snap turn and jump are enabled for Oculus users now (for real this time)! 

There have been some balance changes and fixes. The player models also have updated movement animations.  

As always we are continually trying to fine-tune our game and listening to your feedback! Please let us know what you guys think and keep sending the constructive feedback and ideas our way. 

Here’s the full list of updates below. 

Game Settings:

Attack/Defend mode

Adjusted so that players no longer respawn, and the round will end when the enemy team has been eliminated
Adjusted so that victory conditions have been changed from “destroy all targets” ---> “destroy any target” 
Game time has been reduced to 3 minutes per round 
Players who join mid round will not spawn until the next round 
UI window for selecting weapons is now shown at the beginning of each round

 
BOTs

Bots may now be added to DOM games
Bots are now able to throw grenades 

 

Oculus Rift:

Snap turn support added: push right/left controller's(if you set you as righty/lefty) thumbstick to right or left to do make snap turn 
Jumping now mapped on controller: press button A/X if you set you as righty/lefty 



Maps:


New map “Library” 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31409256/eeff4c7feab59972e1b934436309717548b0fa9f.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31409256/c3255bfa3b61f5d8e23224d758ac54dc8bb4390a.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31409256/259279a9200833e553ad2217c16b3f41f8eb9331.png

Will support Team Deathmatch game mode


Train Factory
 
Attack/Defend mode: Bombsites have been reduced from 3 → 2 for better balancing

 
Abandoned Factory

Adjusted the route in Team Deathmatch game mode.



Weapons:

Helmets are now throwable! 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31409256/5676235998dfb18e86072e4955c09255088582d8.gif
Smoke Grenade may now be carried in the ‘backpack’ 
Knifes now have physics and will interact with the environment (map objects) 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31409256/83eed7db6e11a16808f93ef070c436cbaa4e293e.gif


Balance Changes:

Grenades
 
Are now limited to 2 per player per respawn (grenades do not stack, and players will not have more than 2 per life) 

Sniper Rifles
 
Sniper rifle damage has been adjusted for headshots. It only takes one shot to the head regardless if the enemy player has a helmet on or not. 

Movement

Players now run slightly faster when empty handed or are holding light weapons (ex: pistols, grenades, bombs - Attack/Defend) 



Other
 
Improved animation for all player movements 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31409256/0dd2b409564ddb660a20af4644c24b9baaae0c1e.gif


Upcoming Changes:
 
Reload update: Bolts action/Cocking weapon after reloading.
Accumulated Points and Ranking
Leaderboards
Personal combat record and history
Medal system
New Army
 
Including theme maps, weapon

notes.title: How To Play Front Defense: Heroes on Windows Mixed Reality (WMR)
notes.content:
Hi all, 

We now offically support the WMR headsets with SteamVR please check the instructions below if you have issues setting up your device. 

1.	Make sure your PC is compatible with WMR you can check here: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/mixed-reality/enthusiast-guide/windows-mixed-reality-minimum-pc-hardware-compatibility-guidelines

2.	Make sure Windows 10 is up-to-date. You can check here to see how to update windows: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/4027667/windows-update-windows-10 

3.	Make sure your graphics card driver is up-to-date.

4.	Make sure SteamVR is installed.

5.	Install WMR for SteamVR via Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/app/719950/Windows_Mixed_Reality_for_SteamVR/

6.	Run WMR for SteamVR and setup the boundary.

7.	Pair WMR controllers via WMR for SteamVR (by clicking the icon with 3 dots).

8.	Run Front Defense: Heroes

Troubleshooting:
1.	You may need to activate Windows developer mode if you can’t run WMR for SteamVR normally, here is the link on how to activate it: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ayo4pefuYAY

2.	You may need to use an external Bluetooth dongle if your controllers do not work properly, see the Bluetooth best practice documentation here: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/mixed-reality/enthusiast-guide/troubleshooting-windows-mixed-reality#bluetooth-best-practices

3.	Your WMR HMD should be plugged into USB 3.0 port while your external Bluetooth dongle need to be plugged into USB 2.0 port.

4.	If you activated Windows developer mode, make sure you turn off the simulation for headphone and controllers in the developer options in WMR for SteamVR.

5.	Check out this link for more issues you may have: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/mixed-reality/enthusiast-guide/troubleshooting-windows-mixed-reality

notes.title: v0.94 Update
notes.content:
Greetings Soldiers!

Smooth Locomotion Has Arrived!

The wait is finally over - smooth locomotion has been implemented into the game!

This means that you will be able to play Front Defense Heroes running about in the game - guns blazing, bombs exploding, bullets whizzing past you - just as if you were on an actual battlefield!

We want to thank you for giving us your feedback on how important smooth locomotion is to you and for being patient with us while we worked hard to implement the feature amidst others.

Please tell us what you think of it and keep your constructive feedback and ideas coming. Also, look out for more updates soon as we have quite a lot of cool new features coming up!

Here’s the full list of updates below.


Game Settings
We have revamped the game settings and it is now its own tab different from where you can select your Height, in-game name, movement style, Health bar settings and also added a section to allow users to change their graphic settings
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31409256/5be7422cc81feffb69b7f8bd4e474b9ce391476c.gif

Movement Options
We have added two new movement types in the “Game Settings”

-Locomotion - Smooth/free locomotion (Please take a rest or break if you feel dizzy or uncomfortable or select our Mixed or V-move options)

-Mixed - A mix between our movement types where users can use both locomotion and V-move using their controller’s touchpad

-V-move - Old movement style similar to teleport 

Balance Changes
We found that with the additional of locomotion into our game that some of the guns needed to be balanced. We wanted there to be a variety of play styles and for all the weapon classes to feel unique.

-Sniper Rifles/Carbines
With the additional of locomotion we have lowered the hip fire (1 handed) accuracy of the sniper rifles. Players will have to hold the gun with both hands to steady their aim and fire accurately.



Upcoming Changes
-Control changes - In the next patch we will be removing the trigger option in the game settings menu and will be using the grip option as our default.

Discord Channel
Join us over at Discord here to report bugs, give feedback and also to find games with other players! The devs are usually around so feel free to message us directly! https://discord.gg/R67Af6U

-Adjusted Sniper Rifle Recoil / Accuracy with one hand
-Fixed the Right and Left hand options (Left handed mode – Gun will be in left hand and movement will be on the right hand controller)

04/10/2018
-Fix the issue that loading screen doesn't close after loading
-Fix the issue that the same damage is counted for multiple times

notes.title: Version 0.93 update
notes.content:
Greeting Soldiers! 
 
Quick update from the Front Defense: Heroes team! 

As always, we are hard at work implementing other features and smooth locomotion. For the time being, please enjoy these two new maps.


Maps
During World War 2, bitter wars were fought between opposing forces and many of them took place in locations like castles and underground bunkers. Today, we are bringing you 2 new maps to relive the experience.

Castle on the hill 
-Play FFA or team deathmatch on this map where both teams spawn on either side of the castle. Teams will need to fight for highground within the castle walls in order to gain the high ground.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31409256/cfc37bddb368feef3e7b6f3c6b74e65e3309f43b.png

Bunker
-Play team deathmatch on this deceptively simple and thrilling map. Be prepared for a high kill count as this small map means there are enemies around every corner! 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31409256/5d01f11dff4a16fa691f2ef963852a0f9b1a64cd.png
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31409256/5d81958a76a1e0aafbbcaa1343b5e135ed9f4423.png

Bug fixes
Mar. 9, 2018
Fix the issue that players can't move in game if they skipped to set their height.

Mar. 12, 2018
Fix the issue that the battle stats will have two entries for one player if the player disconnected and reconnected in game
